Name: Item Bags for Sunberry Village
Author: sankayoudead
Description:
These item bags were created to suit my own playthrough, but they're highly customizable as any other ItemBag extension.

[b]Included are:[/b]

Fishing Bag (for storing fishies - purchasable at Willy's)
Crops and Forage Bag (for storing purchasable at Pierre's)
Seeds and Saplings Bag (for storing seeds and saplings - purchasable at Pierre's)
Mining and Artifacts Bag (for storing gems, geodes and artifacts - purchasable at Clint's and Dwarf's)
Cooking and Alchemy Bag (for storing cooking products, alchemy items and animal products - purchasable at Gus's)
(Optional) AIl-In-One Bag (for when you're like my pet rabbit overlord who likes to hoard her fruit, veggies, toys and trash in one place - purchasable at Krobus's)

[b]Installation:[/b]

Simply extract the JSON files from the provided ZIP archive into your ...Mods\ItemBags\assets\Modded Bags folder. 

All credit goes to the Sunberry team for making [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]the amazing mod[/url] and thank you, skellady, for the permission. <3
